name: What are the warning signs my roof is about to start leaking?

mainEntity.name: What are the warning signs my roof is about to start leaking?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Common early warning signs include **curling or missing shingles/tiles**, cracked or loose flashing, granules in gutters, and any interior stains on ceilings or walls. On flat roofs, ponding water or soft spots are big red flags.

Roofs often show these symptoms weeks or months before a visible “drip” occurs. By the time you see active dripping, water may have been in your insulation, framing, or drywall for a while.

Key factors:
- Dark spots or bubbling paint on ceilings and upper walls
- Moldy or musty odors in upper rooms or the attic
- Shingles losing granules, blistering, or lifting in wind
- Sagging areas or standing water on flat sections

If you spot any of these, don’t wait for the next storm. Photograph what you see and call a roofer for an inspection, asking them to check attic spaces too. Early repairs are almost always cheaper than waiting until water reaches your living spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Early signs include interior stains, musty odors, curling or missing shingles/tiles, loose or rusted flashing, granules in gutters, and ponding water on flat roofs. If you see any of these, schedule an inspection before the next big storm to avoid bigger repair bills.
